title: Embodied Cognition and Somatic Idioms in Hungarian

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Cognitive linguistics demonstrates that human concepts originate in bodily experience (*testesülés*). Hungarian features hundreds of idioms based on anatomy: the head represents intellect (*fejét töri, fejébe vesz*), the heart represents emotion and conscience (*szívére vesz, szívvel-lélekkel*), and the hand represents agency (*kézbe vesz, kezet emel*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: When writing advanced analytical essays, somatic metaphors ground abstract assertions in vivid physical intuition without losing register dignity.
